abstract: A 54-year-old female underwent exploratory laparotomy for evaluation of a large abdominopelvic mass. She was found to have a 29-pound multicystic tumor arising from the right ovary. There were no other gross intraabdominal abnormalities. Histologic examination of the mass revealed a mucinous cystadenocarcinoma of low malignant potential and a mature cystic teratoma. To our knowledge, this is the first case report of an ovarian epithelial adenocarcinoma of low malignant potential associated with a mature cystic teratoma.
abstract_ja: 54歳の女性が、右卵巣から発生した多嚢胞性腫瘍（29ポンド）の評価のため開腹術を受けた。肉眼的に他の腹腔内異常は認められなかった。組織学的検査では、低悪性度の粘液性嚢胞腺癌と成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が認められた。我々の知る限り、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴う卵巣上皮性の低悪性度腺癌の症例はこれが初めての報告である。
